chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So when an investor is considering a particular hedge fund,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: they want to know what are the goals for the hedge fund.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And they'll also want to know the results of certain metrics.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Let's take a look at goals first.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Now you might say, of course my goal is to make money.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Well, it's a little bit finer than that or a little bit more subtle than that.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: There are of course other potential goals, but

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: these two are the primary types of goals that hedge funds go after.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: One type is to beat a benchmark.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: What does that mean?

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Let's suppose for instance that you've got a strategy that looks at the stocks that

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: are in the S&P 500.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: There's 500 of them of course.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And you're especially smart at picking out the good ones.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So you might build a hedge fund whose goal is to beat the S&P 500

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: index as a benchmark because you're wise at selecting among all those which stocks

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: are going to outperform.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And of course the overall index has the good stocks and the bad stocks.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So you're going to do better because you picked the specific good ones.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: An important component of the beat a benchmark model is that many benchmarks,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: like the stock market as a whole, for which S&P 500 is a good representative, go down.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And it is of course natural that a portfolio consisted of stocks from this index

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: might go down as well.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So even though both the index and the fund go down,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: you can outperform the index by going down less.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So this kind of fund that is tagged against a benchmark can still meet performance goals

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: if it goes down so long as that index is going down more.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: That brings us to absolute return funds.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Their goal is to provide positive return no matter what.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: These funds are usually long short, which means they make positive bets in stocks they

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: think are going to go up.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And they make negative bets in stocks they're going to go down.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: We'll talk about shorting a little bit later.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: In any case, their objective is to make slow, gradual, positive return no matter what.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Often these types of funds don't make the same percentage gains as the B to benchmark

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: fund, but they have very low drawdowns.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: In other words, when the market takes a big hit, they often don't.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: The next question is, well, how do we measure how well that fund is meeting those goals?

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: We talked about these metrics in the mini-course, Manipulating Financial Data in Python.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: But we'll repeat it just a little bit here to remind you.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And also to bring those folks up to speed who didn't necessarily have that previous course.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Cumulative return is a measure of, you know, given the amount of funds I started with,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: how much more did I end up with after a certain period of time.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So suppose we have an NDA array of values of our portfolio,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: where zero is the first value and minus one is the very last one.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: We can easily compute cumulative return by dividing that last value by the first value

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: and subtracting one.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So for instance, if we made 20% over a year, this would end up being 0.2.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Volatility is a measure of how rapidly and aggressively the portfolio goes up and

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: down in value.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And of course, lower volatility is better.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Volatility is simply measured as the standard deviation of daily returns.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: The last factor here, which is a measure of the ratio of risk to reward,

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: is typically measured using Sharpe ratio.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And the Sharpe ratio is calculated like this.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Sharpe ratio is also sometimes called risk-adjusted reward.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So you can consider that to be reward divided by risk.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Our reward is our average daily return minus the risk-free rate.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And our risk is simply a measure of that standard deviation of daily returns or

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: volatility.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: We multiply that ratio by the square root of 252.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: That is how many trading days there are in a year.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And remember, we're always working with daily returns.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So that's why we use this 252 number.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So recapping, hedge funds have goals, typically either to beat a particular

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: benchmark or to gain absolute return.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And then metrics by which we judge how well they accomplish those goals.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So cumulative return, how much did they make over a period of time?

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Volatility, how volatile were they over that time?

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And then risk-adjusted reward or Sharpe ratio.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: One thing I want to mention before I leave this topic with regard to benchmarks is

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: the benchmark you choose should depend on the expertise you have.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: So let's suppose you're an expert in Eastern Europe and

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: you're great at picking stocks in emerging markets in Eastern Europe.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: You should select some benchmark that represents that similar kind of investing.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: And there are indexes that represent emerging markets in Eastern Europe.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: There are also other funds whose values you might use as a benchmark.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: Or let's say your expertise is in banks.

chunks.title: Hedge fund goals and metrics
chunks.text: You might choose an index for the baking industry and show that you can beat that.
